info.name: Cassini Live
info.summary: Private, multilingual live captions for Nextcloud Talk, powered by Whistle.
info.description:
Turn on captions in Talk and follow the conversation in real time. Whistle recognises English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch and Polish on your CPU. Language detection is automatic. Audio and captions stay on your infrastructure; no account, API key, GPU, recording or end-user configuration is needed.
Requires Talk's high-performance backend, AppAPI and a deploy daemon. Supply the HPB internal secret once in deploy options; its URL is discovered from Talk. Whistle is bundled in the image.
Cassini Live is a companion to Cassini recordings. It replaces the official Live Transcription ExApp because Talk currently requires the live_transcription app ID. Install only one provider. This is an initial development release, not yet published to the Nextcloud App Store.
info.author: codemyriad

variable.name: CASSINI_TALK_SIGNALING_INTERNAL_SECRET
variable.description: One-time installation value. The signalling server's [clients] internalsecret, not the shared secret in Talk settings. On AIO: docker exec nextcloud-aio-talk printenv INTERNAL_SECRET.

variable.name: CASSINI_TALK_HPB_URL
variable.description: Leave empty to discover from Talk. Override only when the container needs a different address.

variable.name: CASSINI_LIVE_WORKERS
variable.description: Leave empty for CPU quota sizing, up to four recognition workers. The installation check measures usable simultaneous speakers. Silent tracks do not reserve workers. Range: 1 to 32.

variable.name: CASSINI_LIVE_DEBUG_VIDEO
variable.description: Set to 1 to show aggregate server metrics as a video participant in the first captioned room. Visible to everyone there. One feed per server, 0.5 fps; stops under resource pressure. Default off.
